part.text: All 17 tests pass. Quick sanity check of the reported case:

Fixed. The bug was in `printf_arg_formatter::operator()` (include/fmt/printf.h:286): the char branch unconditionally reset `fmt_specs.align = align::right`, clobbering the `align::left` set by the `-` flag in `parse_flags`. It now preserves left alignment:

```cpp
fmt_specs.align = fmt_specs.align == align::left ? align::left : align::right;
```

Verified:
- `fmt::printf("X%-5cX", 'a')` now outputs `Xa    X`, matching `std::printf`
- `printf-test` passes, including the `%-5c` case in test/printf-test.cc:162
- Full suite: 17/17 tests pass
